name: BabelDOC
translationProvider: Page-batched GPT via the existing ChatGPT-signed-in Codex CLI and dedicated native JSONL helper
compatibilityNotes: BabelDOC imports BitStream, removed by bitstring 5.
Direct BabelDOC internal API is pinned and covered by real-engine PDF regression.
Dual PDF composition uses visible crop/rotation geometry and vector PDF forms.
Upstream paragraph SQLite cache is disabled; job retention controls document copies.
Python PDF workers remain offline; only the text-only isolated Codex helper translates quoted page segments.
Completed outputs are keyed by document hash, physical pages, language pair and translation revision.
